messages.author: 22aafb2aa2902d9d
messages.subject: Change error stat_smooth loess
parts:
Is it possible to change the error term on stat_smooth using the
default loess fitting? At present this displays a 95% CI, which as far
as I can determine is calulated as SE * 1.96. Although there is a
"level" option, this only appears to affect other fitting functions
such as lm, it has no effect when using loess. Is it possible to
adjust the 1.96 multiplier to give different levels of significance?

Thankyou,

Samuel Dennis

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Change error stat_smooth loess
parts:
Not presently - unfortunately predict.loess (which actually computes
the standard errors) doesn't support the level argument.

Hadley
